payload.core_composition_summary: Sorting by value enables greedy two-pointer expansion to check if each k-compression forms a permutation.
payload.rationale: The algorithm first sorts (value, index) pairs. Then it uses a two-pointer technique that greedily extends an interval from the ends, processing values in increasing order, to determine for which k the compression is a permutation.
